is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) marker (Page 9, Table 3; Page 11, Table 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 and Table 5 provide genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for the L1014F (L995F) marker in An. gambiae s.l. populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in 30 districts of Yaoundé, Cameroon (Page 1, Abstract; Page 3, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original research article reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in 30 districts of Yaoundé, Cameroon, and provides a map of these sites (Page 4, Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were performed from March 2017 to March 2018 (Page 3, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection of mosquitoes from 2017-2018.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts, are provided in the main text tables (Table 3 and Table 5).

assessment.summary: This study assessed malaria transmission dynamics and insecticide resistance in Anopheles mosquitoes in Yaoundé, Cameroon, between 2017 and 2018. It reports high resistance to DDT and pyrethroids and provides genotype counts for the L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation in An. gambiae s.l.
